hooks.command: bash -c 'file=$(jq -r .tool_input.file_path 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$file" ] || [ "$file" = "null" ] && exit 0; case "$file" in *schema.prisma) npx --no-install prisma format --schema "$file" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;; */db/schema*.ts|*/drizzle/schema*.ts|*/schema.ts) npx --no-install prettier --write "$file" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;; esac; exit 0'
